Container.Name: CosyVoice3-API
Container.Overview: OpenAI-compatible Text-to-Speech API powered by CosyVoice 3 (Alibaba FunAudioLLM). State-of-the-art Chinese TTS with 18 dialects, 9 languages, built-in voices, instruction-based control, and zero-shot voice cloning. CUDA 12.8 (Blackwell/Ada/Ampere). First start downloads model files (~10GB) from HuggingFace. Supports RTX 50-series GPUs. China users: set HF_ENDPOINT to https://hf-mirror.com for faster downloads. Requires NVIDIA GPU with driver 550+.

Config.Name: API Port
Config.Description: OpenAI-compatible TTS API port. Swagger docs at /docs

Config.Name: Model Cache
Config.Description: Model download cache. First run downloads ~10GB. Persists across container recreates.

Config.Name: Model ID
Config.Description: HuggingFace model ID. Restart required after change.

Config.Name: HuggingFace Endpoint
Config.Description: HuggingFace download endpoint. China users: change to https://hf-mirror.com for faster downloads.

Config.Name: FP16
Config.Description: Half-precision inference. Reduces VRAM by ~50%. Disable (false) only if you experience quality issues.
